title: ADVERTISEMENT FOR THE PART TIME FACULTY POSITIONS IN THE SUBJECT OF LAW
text:
KEY LINES:
Minimum Qualification is as per UGC/P.U. norms.

FULL TEXT:
UNIVERSITY INSTITUTE OF LEGAL STUDIES
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH
ADVERTISEMENT FOR THE PART TIME FACULTY POSITIONS IN
THE SUBJECT OF LAW
Faculty positions No. of
seats
Honorarium Duration
Part-time Faculty in
Law
03 Rs. 43,275/- per month
fixed
Session
2024-25
Minimum Qualification is as per UGC/P.U. norms.
(https://www.ugc.gov.in/pdfnews/5323630_New_Draft_UGCRegulation-
2018-9-2.pdf )
All the applicants are advised to send/submit their applications to the
Director, University Institute of Legal Studies, Panjab University,
Chandigarh along with all self attested copies of their certificates and other
relevant documents including publications for verification along with the
duly filled application form and template pages 1 to 11
(https://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429-
directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformasperugcregulation2018.
pdf ) on or before 18th July, 2024 by 4:00 pm. (Late applications will not
be considered)
At the time (11:00 a.m) of interview (physical presence is mandatory) on 23rd
July, 2024 at office of Director UILS, PU Chandigarh, candidates are
required to bring all the supporting documents/certificates/publications in
original. Candidates are required to report at 09:30 a.m on the date of
interview. Kindly be in touch with Panjab University and UILS website for
further updates.
The candidate shall have to give an undertaking that he/she will not draw
any fellowship/stipend or any financial assistance from any agency till they
are teaching at University Institute of Legal Studies, Panjab University,
Chandigarh as a Guest / Part-Time Faculty.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Extendable as per Panjab University Rules/Norms.
